about: The ten moments on the timeline. For each: the airport report it shows (time, Dubai time, must match a report in april-2024.json), why it was chosen (shown in the panel), and an optional news text. Moments were chosen by hand (interpretive). The camera stays over the airport for all of them. The news text is shown under the readings once placeholder is false and text is filled in, with its source (publication, date) and url.
